business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture and Canning of Retort River Snail Noodles (Luosifen)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 10/2010 on the Prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (as amended by Law 7/2021), Royal Decree 304/2014 regulating the UBO Register, and Directive (EU) 2018/843

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Extract from Commercial Register
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent authority in country of origin
Notary Public in country of origin
Competent authority in country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against Spanish, EU, UN, OFAC, and domestic sanctions/PEP lists using certified databases

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central (Central Registry of Mercantile Companies)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Spanish language and Latin alphabet only; no transliteration permitted
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Words suggesting public authority or official status
Names of political parties or trade unions
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: File administrative appeal before the Commercial Registry within one month of notification of rejection; failure allows judicial review before the Audiencia Provincial

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Accepted for SL companies provided the address is a real postal address with postal services and the company can be contacted at that address
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low risk at pre-incorporation stage; increases to medium during subsequent food manufacturing licensing and inspections by Ministry of Health

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of incorporation documents and UBO declaration
Hague Apostille and consular legalization fees
International corporate legal due diligence and UBO piercing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate for multinational setup

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio, por el que se aprueba el texto refundido de la Ley de Sociedades de Capital (LSC), particularly Artículos 20 (Forma), 21 (Escritura e Inscripción), 22 (Contenido de la Escritura), 60-73 (Régimen de las Participaciones), 209-234 (Órganos de Administración), 236-250 (Responsabilidad), and 330-336 (Cuentas Anuales).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (RMERC) for the name certificate and the Registro Mercantil Provincial del domicilio social for the definitive registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución de Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada (public deed of incorporation) formally executed before a Spanish Notary and subsequently recorded in the Registro Mercantil.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The standard minimum paid-up capital for a Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada is EUR 3,000, fully subscribed and paid in cash or in kind. Pursuant to the 'Ley Crea y Crece' (Law 18/2022), formation is permitted with a capital from EUR 1, provided that, until reaching the EUR 3,000 threshold, at least 20% of annual profits must be allocated to the legal reserve. The capital subscription must be fully paid up at the moment of execution of the deed. No escrow account is legally required for cash contributions; payment is evidenced by the notary's declaration and, where applicable, a bank capital-deposit certificate if paid in cash. The administrator must deposit the funds in a Spanish bank account within two months after registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: In Madrid, Spain, on the date of incorporation, the sole incorporator of Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada [Company] adopts the following resolutions: (1) Each founder subscribes one or more participations of EUR 1.00 par value, fully paid in cash, and such subscription is accepted; (2) the registered office is fixed at Calle de la Seda 12, 28045 Madrid, Spain, and the secretary is instructed to notify the Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria and the Registro Mercantil; (3) [Full Name] is appointed sole administrator and [Compliance Officer] is appointed as secretary responsible for corporate records and legal compliance; (4) the administrator and the notary are jointly authorized to execute all filings, registrations, and payments required for the incorporation and for obtaining the NIF and the food industry operating license.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (online portal: https://www.rmc.es, or at client facing expediente service)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the online application form (denominación social) with the NIE/passport of the promoters and the intended corporate name. The registry issues a negative certification ('certificación negativa de denominación social') confirming the name is not already registered. If the name is identical to an existing company, the system automatically suggests alternatives; the applicant must resubmit for the modified preferred name.
required_dossiers: Formulario de denominación social (official application form)
Copy of DNI/NIE/passport of each promoter
Brief description of the corporate object in Spanish
Payment of the certification fee (approximately EUR 12)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In case of a negative certificate, file a new application with up to three alternative names in order of preference; the certificate is valid for 3 months and can be renewed once. If the defect is missing documentation, submit the missing item online after notification from the registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any Spanish credit institution (Bank of Spain regulated entity)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional corporate bank account in the name of the SL and deposit the full subscribed capital (minimum EUR 1 under the reformed law, typically EUR 3,000). The bank issues a deposit certificate ('certificado de desembolso') indicating the account holder, capital amount, and date. For non-cash contributions, appoint an independent expert to value assets; this is not required for cash contributions. The certificate is delivered to the notary.
required_dossiers: Application form for corporate account opening
Name clearance certificate from the Registro Mercantil Central
Copy of statutory draft by-laws (borrador de estatutos)
CIF/NIE of each promoter (or tax identification for non-residents)
Anti-money-laundering identification questionnaire
Certificate of residence of each director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses the account opening, obtain a notarized declaration in lieu of deposit (declaración notarial de aportación de capital) and address any AML queries with additional proof of source of funds and residence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Public Incorporation Deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (Notario) in the jurisdiction of the future registered office (e.g., Madrid or Valencia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Attend the notary in person or via power of attorney. Submit the name certificate, capital deposit certificate, draft by-laws, and identification documents. The notary reviews the lawfulness of the by-laws, reads the deed aloud, obtains the consent of the promoters, and issues a certified copy (copia autorizada) and six first copies. The deed must contain the company name, object, registered office, share capital, participation structure, administration regime, founders' private information, and the express declaration of subscription and payment of each participation.
required_dossiers: Name certificate (certificación negativa de denominación social)
Certificate of capital deposit or notarial declaration of payment
Draft estatutos (articles of association) in Spanish
DNI/NIE/passport of all founding partners and the appointed administrator
Tax identification number of each founder
Modelo 600 (Información de la operación societaria de constitución) if deemed subject to transfer tax in certain jurisdictions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary observes a defect in the by-laws or capital evidence, the promoter must cure the issue by approved amendments to the by-laws or re-execution of the deposit certificate. In case of legal interpretation of non-resident ownership, legalize and translate any foreign corporate resolutions and obtain the endorsement of the notary after review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Transfer Tax and Stamp Duty (ITPAJD)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Consejería de Hacienda de la Comunidad Autónoma where the company has its registered office (online portal of the regional tax authority)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Modelo 600 self-assessment within 30 business days of notarization. The reduced rate for incorporation of an SL is either 0% (Levante regions) or 1% of the capital subscribed, subject to the regional general rules. Pay the resulting fee and obtain a stamped copy (documento justificativo de pago) to present to the Commercial Registry, the Tax Agency, and the notary's protocol.
required_dossiers: Modelo 600 (Impuesto de Transmisiones Patrimoniales y Actos Jurídicos Documentados)
First copy of the public deed
Justification of capital deposit
Calculation of the taxable base (amount of share capital)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the regional office raises a payment query, correct the Modelo 600 and pay the adjusted amount plus late interest if applicable. Obtain from the registry office a certificate of non-assessment if the regional law grants an exemption.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive Registration in the Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial correspondiente al domicilio social (e.g., Registro Mercantil de Madrid)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the four signed copies of the deed (abreviated as 'primera copia'), the ITPAJD payment receipt, and, if applicable, the bank capital certificate to the provincial commercial registry. The registrar reviews compliance with capital, object, and administration rules and makes the inscription in the 'hoja registral'. The registration grants public faith and the company acquires full legal personality. The registry returns sealed copies with the assigned registration number.
required_dossiers: First notarial copy of the public deed of incorporation
Modelo 600 paid stamp certificate
Tax identification number application (modelo 036) stamped by the tax agency
DNI/NIE of the appointed administrator
Declaration of the final registered office
Proof of payment of the registration fee (approximately EUR 45)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a 'calificación negativa' (negative entry), correct the defect identified in the notice within 15 business days. If the defect is substantive (e.g., insufficient capital, invalid by-laws), execute a supplementary deed before the notary or amend the by-laws and re-enter. The registration must be made within two months after the deed; otherwise extend or request reinstatement through the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtaining the Tax Identification Number (NIF) and Fiscal Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) – Oficina de Entidades Jurídicas or online at sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Censo de empresarios (Modelo 036) along with a copy of the first copy of the deed and proof of the provisional registration in the Commercial Registry (or evidence of submission). AEAT issues the provisional NIF immediately, valid until the Commercial Registry inscription is completed. After definitive registration, the company must submit a corrected Modelo 036 within 10 business days to obtain the definitive NIF. Simultaneously declare the beginning of activity (subject to the food manufacturing classification) and, if required, apply for electronic certification for tax filings.
required_dossiers: Modelo 036 (Censo de obligados tributarios)
Copy of the public deed (first copy or notarized photocopy)
Provisional NIF certificate issued by AEAT
Definitive registration certificate from Registro Mercantil
Administrator's DNI/NIE and power of attorney, if any
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AEAT rejects the application due to incomplete deed or pending registry registration, provide a recent copy of the repono (charges statement) from the registry or wait until the definitive registry registration is available. Missing information must be supplied through an error-correction procedure (módulo de subsanación) within 15 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Dirección General de Industria, Alimentación y Comercio de la Consejería de Industria (ministerial scope under Ministerio de Industria, Comercio y Turismo), acting together with the Agencia Española de Seguridad Alimentaria y Nutrición (AESAN) for food safety registration.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorización Sanitaria de Funcionamiento para Industria Alimentaria número RGSAN; registration in the Registro General Sanitario de Empresas Alimentarias (RGSEAA) under active food-operation category, complemented by the municipal Licencia de Actividad/Exercise of Economic Activity and, where applicable, the 'Autorización Ambiental Unificada' for industrial premises.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico (MITECO) in coordination with the Dirección General de Calidad y Evaluación Ambiental de la Comunidad Autónoma (e.g., Consejería de Medio Ambiente de Madrid).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Categoria B – Subject to a simplified environmental impact assessment (evaluación de impacto ambiental simplificada) under Annex II of Ley 21/2013, because the manufacturing of instant rice noodles involves food production with an installed capacity not exceeding 300 tonnes/year and is not listed in Annex I. For facilities with a capacity above 300 tonnes/year, a full EIA report (Categoria A) would be required; smaller startups may qualify as 'Registro con informe preliminar' if the municipal activity license demonstrates compliance with less-than-significant impacts.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges must comply with Royal Decree 1620/2007 for reuse and the urban sanitation parameters of the municipality (COD below 300 mg/L, BOD5 below 150 mg/L, suspended solids below 200 mg/L, and pH 6-9). Atmospheric VOC emissions are limited to 50 mg/Nm3 under EU Directive 2004/42/EC, and combustion exhaust is limited to CO 500 mg/Nm3 and NOx 300 mg/Nm3. Waste management must follow the hierarchy in Law 7/2022 on waste and contaminated soils, including the compulsory registration of the food by-products as organic waste, and the prevention of bioaerosol release from flour handling.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The manufacturing facility must obtain (i) the 'Certificado de Seguridad Contra Incendios' issued by the regional fire department or an authorized vehicle inspection company, verifying compliance with Real Decreto 513/2017 on fire safety in industrial establishments; (ii) the 'Inspección Técnica de Edificios' (ITE) or structural load certificate for the production hall, ensuring the floor load and vibration tolerance of the rice-noodle extrusion and retort lines; and (iii) the 'Comunicación de Apertura del Centro de Trabajo' filed with the Ministry of Labour and Social Economy, attesting to workplace health and safety conformity, including the food-safety personal protective equipment protocol and the occupation-exposure limit for instant-rice-noodle dust (10 mg/m3 for inhalable dust). A local municipal inspection must verify hygiene zoning, drainage, ventilation, and fire-exit dimensions before the operating license is issued.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), through its electronic office (Sede Electrónica de la AEAT). For an ordinary Spanish Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada (SL), the AEAT administers national corporate income tax and VAT; regional authorities administer certain taxes outside this dossier's scope.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Obtain a Spanish tax identification number (NIF) for the SL through incorporation and registration with the Spanish Commercial Registry; the provisional NIF is requested from the AEAT, normally using Modelo 036, and the definitive NIF is obtained after registration documents are supplied. Register the entity's tax activities and applicable obligations using Modelo 036 before commencing taxable activity. A foreign-established business without a Spanish establishment that must register for Spanish VAT generally applies to the AEAT for a Spanish NIF and VAT registration before its first taxable Spanish transaction; a non-EU business may be required to appoint a Spanish tax representative, subject to applicable international-assistance arrangements. For intra-EU transactions, request registration in the Register of Intra-Community Operators (ROI) through Modelo 036 and verify the VAT number through VIES. Provide formation and registry documents, proof of identity and authority of representatives, registered-office details, and any required Spanish translations or legalization. An NIE is generally required for foreign individuals acting as directors or representatives.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: A Spanish SL is generally a separate corporate income taxpayer; Spain has no US-style check-the-box election to treat an SL as a disregarded entity or partnership. Eligible corporate groups may elect, subject to statutory conditions and timely notification, for the Spanish consolidated corporate income tax regime. Spanish tax law also contains special regimes and rules implementing hybrid-mismatch measures, but these do not constitute a general entity-classification election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido, IVA); Spain also applies regional indirect-tax regimes in the Canary Islands, Ceuta, and Melilla, which are outside the ordinary mainland and Balearic Islands VAT territory.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general domestic VAT turnover threshold: a taxable business generally must register and account for VAT from the commencement of taxable activity. Special rules, including the EU cross-border SME scheme and distance-selling rules, may apply where their conditions are met.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Spain does not generally require real-time AEAT clearance or digital stamping of every domestic VAT invoice. The Suministro Inmediato de Información (SII) system requires specified taxpayers, including certain large businesses and VAT-group members, to transmit invoice-register data electronically to the AEAT within statutory periods. Other businesses must comply with applicable invoicing and accounting-system integrity requirements; the Veri*Factu timetable and obligations depend on the applicable implementing rules and taxpayer category. The Crea y Crece Law provides for mandatory electronic invoicing between businesses, with implementation subject to regulations and phased effective dates. Confirm current applicability and commencement dates before deployment.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Qualifying supplies of goods dispatched or transported from the VAT territory of the European Union to a destination outside it may be exempt with the right to deduct input VAT under Spanish VAT law, provided the supplier can substantiate the export and satisfies applicable documentary and invoicing requirements. A non-EU customer's status alone does not make a supply of goods an export. Services are not automatically zero-rated as exports: their treatment depends on place-of-supply rules, customer status, service type, and any applicable exemption or special rule. Supplies of goods to VAT-registered customers in another EU Member State are generally treated under the separate intra-Community supply rules, not as exports.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Export customs declaration and evidence of customs exit from the European Union, including the export accompanying document and exit confirmation where available
Commercial invoice and sales contract or purchase order identifying the goods, customer, destination, and transaction
Bill of lading, airway bill, CMR, or other transport documentation linking the goods to the non-EU destination
Packing list and relevant warehouse, carrier, and delivery records
Accounting records and evidence of consideration received; Spain does not generally require an inward remittance certificate as a prescribed export-VAT document
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Spain has no general statutory foreign-exchange repatriation deadline for export proceeds. If export exemption is unsupported or incorrectly claimed, the AEAT may assess the VAT due, late-payment interest, and applicable tax penalties; deductions or refunds attributable to the incorrectly treated transaction may be adjusted or recovered. Penalties depend on the conduct, tax shortfall, and procedural facts. Maintain contemporaneous customs, transport, commercial, and accounting evidence and respond to audit requests within statutory deadlines.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain) as the national monetary authority and prudential supervisor; the Dirección General de Comercio Internacional e Inversiones (DGCOMII) of the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Business administers the Foreign Investment Register (Registro de Inversiones Exteriores), which is the competent body for post-transaction FDI statistical filings and any national-security screening coordination.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible in both current and capital account transactions under Article 63 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU). Spain imposes no prior exchange-control authorization for profit remittances or dividend distributions by an SL; the only operational barriers are corporate withholding obligations (19% dividend withholding unless an EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive exemption applies), the requirement to file the annual corporate income tax return (Form 200) and associated withholding declaration (Form 123/193), and the compulsory balance-of-payments statistical declaration to Banco de España for operations with non-residents equal to or exceeding €50,000 (or cumulative balances equal to or exceeding €100,000). Profit repatriation is therefore legally unfettered but administratively conditioned on adequate tax filing and banking evidence of economic substance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export proceeds surrender rule or mandatory conversion ratio exists in Spain or in the Eurosystem. Exporters may freely hold foreign currency in resident foreign-currency accounts or non-resident accounts, and may choose the timing and counterparty of FX conversion. Nevertheless, the exporter must report each export receipt to Banco de España for external statistics (balance-of-payments) purposes; the monthly statistical declaration must be submitted electronically with a statutory deadline generally falling within 30 days after the end of the reporting month for single transactions of at least €50,000, and must include the transaction code, invoice reference, counterparty identification, and the underlying customs declaration. Purely commercial late-payment risk is mitigated by complying with the payment terms in the sale contract, not by any regulatory surrender condition.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium. A fintech EMI is viable only if it is authorized and supervised by Banco de España or another EEA regulator and passporting under the Second Payment Services Directive (PSD2), and only for euro-denominated SEPA treasury operations. An EU-licensed EMI can offer multi-currency pool accounts, faster onboarding, and API-based liquidity monitoring, but cannot serve as a primary end-to-end clearing rail for high-value trade settlement because most Spanish EMIs lack direct TARGET2 membership and rely on a sponsoring bank. Off-shore digital EMIs domiciled outside the EEA have Low viability as primary clearing rails: they cannot open Spanish pass-through accounts, cannot issue Spanish IBANs without a local licensed partner, are subject to segregated fund and safeguarding requirements under Spanish Law 16/2009 on payment services, and pose concentrated counterparty and AML risk for the manufacturing entity's treasury. Legal constraint: only entities holding a valid Spanish or EEA payment institution authorization may provide payment accounts; any account opened remotely by a non-EEA EMI must be structured through an EU-licensed institution and disclosed to the Spanish compliance function.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors and beneficial owners are not statutorily required to appear physically for every onboarding step, but tier-1 Spanish banks consistently require at least one director with a Spanish NIE (Número de Identificación de Extranjero) to attend the initial notarial signing and the bank interview in person before activating high-value incoming/outgoing wire channels. Remote onboarding is permitted under Law 10/2010 on prevention of money laundering when the bank applies an eIDAS-certified qualified electronic identification and the notarial deed of incorporation, apostilled powers of attorney, and sworn translations into Spanish are filed electronically. However, a hybrid protocol is the market norm: physical attendance of the majority shareholder or sole director at the bank's compliance interview, accompanied by the corporate secretary and the tax advisor, with UBOs identified through a live video call and a valid passport/NIE. The bank may also mandate an on-site visit before granting MT103-capable internet banking with no daily transaction cap.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) chain with intermediate non-EU holding vehicles in jurisdictions subject to enhanced due diligence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Consolidated group organizational chart with direct and indirect shareholding percentages, sworn UBO declaration (Form 1) signed by each individual with over 25% control, notarized and apostilled corporate registry extract of the intermediate entities, audited financial statements of the foreign parent, and a written narrative explaining the commercial purpose of each vehicle.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between the declared factory purpose (instant rice noodles manufacturing, ISIC 1079) and the requested banking product (large-volume cross-border RMB/USD wires to Asian procurement hubs)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete procurement evidence package: signed rice/seasoning/packaging supply contracts, pro-forma and final suppliers' invoices, customs tariff classifications (HS codes 1006, 2103, 1902, 3920), EU phytosanitary import certificates, quality and food-safety certificates (ISO 22000, HACCP), warehouse lease agreements, and the projected monthly purchase-to-sale waterfall model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Political exposure or PEP status of a non-resident investor/financial backer
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due diligence file: PEP declaration with source-of-wealth and source-of-funds report, notarized tax clearance certificate from the investor's country of residence, list of personal and corporate banking relationships in the last five years, independent legal opinion confirming the legitimacy of the funds, and the executed board resolution approving the investment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection consisting of intra-group loans or third-party advances rather than pure equity contribution
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Formal participation loan agreement (préstamo participativo) or shareholder loan agreement with notarial signature, current corporate book entry showing the liability, evidence of the bank-account trail from the originating institution (SWIFT MT103/MT950 statements), transfer-pricing documentation showing arm's length interest rate, and the Spanish foreign investment declaration (Form D-2) filed with DGCOMII.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of concentrated crypto-assets or unverifiable digital payment venues in the group's financial history
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited bank statements covering a 24-month history in regulated financial institutions, sworn statement that no crypto proceeds are used for the capital injection or operational treasury, traceable fiat trail through EBICS/API logs, and an independent AML audit report if any residual crypto touchpoint is identified.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing for equity and shareholder-loan injections is a SWIFT MT103/TT wire naming the depositor's external bank and the beneficiary as the Spanish SL (IBAN ES..) with remittance information in Field 70 reading 'APORTACIÓN AL CAPITAL SOCIAL – [SL name] – NIF [tax ID] – Escritura de Constitución', or, for a shareholder loan, 'PRÉSTAMO PARTICIPATIVO – [SL name] – [date of agreement]'. The bank will require the notarial deed of incorporation, the notary certificate of capital deposit (certificado de depósito) if the account is the incorporation escrow, the D-2 foreign-investment declaration filed with the Electronic Register of Foreign Investments (within one month of the operation for direct investments; no prior-approval requirement for non-screened activities), a source-of-funds questionnaire, and confirmation that the investment does not trigger the Spanish foreign investment screening regime under Royal Decree-Law 8/2020, which in any case does not apply to an instant rice noodle manufacturing project. Verification of the injected funds is performed by matching the SWIFT fields with the notarial deed, the contribution resolution, and the bank's sanctions/OFAC screening; funds must remain in the account until the notary's final disposition for registration in the Mercantile Registry.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements for raw materials and machinery are executed through (a) SWIFT MT103 direct telegraphic transfers for recurring payments to vetted suppliers, with Field 70 referencing the invoice/contract and Field 72 identifying the purpose code; (b) Commercial Letters of Credit (UCP 600) issued or confirmed by the Spanish bank for high-value rice and retort-pouch purchases, with documents comprising the bill of lading, commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, EU health certificate, and HACCP/ISO certificates; (c) Documentary collections (D/P or D/A) for medium-risk counterparties; and (d) SEPA Credit Transfers for suppliers resident in the EEA. All payments must be consistent with the corporate object, supported by back-to-back trade documents, and reported in the Banco de España balance-of-payments statistical declaration where the €50,000 threshold is met.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX Forward (outright EUR/CNY, EUR/USD, EUR/VND) executed under an ISDA Master Agreement with a Spanish or EU credit institution and subject to EMIR reporting via a recognized trade repository
FX Swap (spot-forward combination) for managing temporary inflows and export-receipt conversion mismatches
Nondeliverable Forward (NDF) for non-fully-convertible emerging-market currencies (e.g., VND, PHP) when the counterparty is an EEA-authorized bank and the contract is cash-settled in EUR
Cross-Currency Swap (CCS or CURRY) permitting the SL to swap variable-rate EUR debts into fixed-rate USD or CNY obligations for term-aligned trade financing
Vanilla FX Call/Put Options (plain-vanilla, premium-paid) to cap the cost of future procurement in hard currencies
Commodity-price-linked structured forwards covering rice and edible-oil prices provided such instruments qualify as hedging derivatives under IFRS 9 and are disclosed in financial statements

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Legalization of annual statutory accounting books (Libros de Contabilidad)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Commercial Registry (Registro Mercantil Provincial) of the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after fiscal year-end; for 31 December year-end, by 30 April of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late legalization deprives the books of evidentiary value, subjects the company to administrative fines, and blocks subsequent filings in the Commercial Registry; persistent failure contributes to registry default and may lead to forced closure of the registry sheet.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual deposit of annual accounts (Depósito de Cuentas Anuales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Commercial Registry (Registro Mercantil Provincial) of the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after fiscal year-end; for 31 December year-end, by 30 June of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late deposit triggers a fine of EUR 60 to 600 per late year; the company becomes a registry defaulter and its registry sheet is provisionally closed, preventing registration of any instrument except cancellation; three consecutive years of non-deposit may result in judicial dissolution and administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Impuesto sobre Sociedades)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Tax Administration Agency (Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria, AEAT)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months and 25 calendar days after the tax year-end; for 31 December year-end, by 25 July of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers a surcharge of 5% plus 1% per month up to 20% of the tax due; penalties for inaccurate or incomplete returns can reach 150% of the tax assessed; AEAT may embargo bank accounts and other assets; instances of serious intentional non-filing may escalate to criminal tax prosecution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Ultimate beneficial ownership (UBO) annual confirmation embedded in the annual accounts deposit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Commercial Registry (Registro Mercantil Provincial) via the annual accounts filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually with the deposit of annual accounts; for 31 December year-end, by 30 June of the following year; changes in UBO during the year are reflected in that filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to provide accurate UBO confirmation exposes the company and its directors to anti-money laundering penalties under Law 10/2010, ranging from EUR 1,500 to 60,000, and may also cause the Commercial Registry to reject or block the annual accounts deposit.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit is required if the company meets at least two of the following three thresholds for two consecutive fiscal years: total assets exceeding EUR 5,700,000; net annual turnover exceeding EUR 11,400,000; average number of employees exceeding 50. In addition, any company that loses the right to present abbreviated accounts or is expressly required by the articles or by minority shareholders must have an audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish local GAAP (Plan General de Contabilidad, PGC) is the mandatory framework for individual annual accounts; small eligible companies may apply the abbreviated PGC de PYMES; consolidated accounts may be prepared under IFRS-EU in accordance with Regulation (EC) 1606/2002.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Spain does not require a standalone annual UBO return; the annual deposit of annual accounts in the Mercantile Registry includes a UBO declaration (Declaración de Titularidad Real) confirming the ultimate beneficial owners as of the closing date. Any share transfer during the year that changes beneficial ownership must be reflected in the statutory register and in the next annual accounts filing; the declaration is formally certified by the governing body. Companies must continually maintain an internal UBO register and provide updated information to the Commercial Registry whenever required under anti-money laundering legislation.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios)
Register of Directors and Legal Representatives (Libro Registro de Órgano de Administración)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300 - 1,200 per year when professional registered office or local agent services are used; lower if the company uses its own registered premises.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500 - 14,000 per annum for a typical SME audit, depending on turnover, inventory complexity, and auditor risk assessment.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 25% standard rate with R&D tax credits (up to 100% of qualifying expenses) and accelerated depreciation allowances

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 100 Corporate Income Tax Return, submitted electronically via AEAT portal (www.aeat.es)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 25th day of the month following the end of the tax year

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income after adjustments for exempt income, non-deductible expenses and incentives
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Permanent establishment income reported separately; non-residents file via representative or withholding agent

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits for taxes withheld on dividends, royalties and interest received
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidation: Non-residents claim treaty relief through TRC submission to reduce or eliminate WHT

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Administrative fines 100-200% of evaded tax plus daily surcharges of 0.1% per day (maximum 20% of tax due)

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Obtain TRC from Spanish tax authorities, complete Form 210 and submit supporting documentation to AEAT for DTA rate reduction
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 19%; Interest: 19% (treaty-reduced to 0-10% depending on DTA)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Not applicable to manufacturing operations; TP documentation and economic substance requirements apply only to holding or finance companies

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate omission or false declaration of income or deductions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties: fines equivalent to 100-200% of evaded tax and imprisonment up to 5 years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal liability, disqualification from corporate offices, and joint restitution obligations

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare or maintain adequate Local File or Master File documentation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to 1 million EUR or 5% of annual turnover
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal fines and possible disqualification from management roles

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining Spanish entity without real business activities or operational substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Income recharacterization, fines up to 2 million EUR or 10% of turnover, and potential criminal sanctions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing the corporate veil, personal tax liability and possible imprisonment for fraudulent conduct

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to comply with Spanish AML reporting obligations or beneficial ownership disclosure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to 2 million EUR or 10% of annual turnover plus potential criminal prosecution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal fines, disqualification from management, and criminal liability for willful non-compliance
